python3 << 'EOF'
import os
import re

files = [
    'test/invoices.test.js',
    'test/export.test.js', 
    'test/render.test.js',
    'test/payments.test.js',
    'test/reports.test.js'
]

for filename in files:
    if os.path.exists(filename):
        with open(filename, 'r') as f:
            content = f.read()
        
        # Replace qty: 10, with qty: 9, to avoid bulk discount in existing tests
        modified = re.sub(r'qty: 10,', 'qty: 9,', content)
        
        if modified != content:
            with open(filename, 'w') as f:
                f.write(modified)
            print(f"Updated {filename}")
        else:
            print(f"No changes needed in {filename}")

EOF
